summary: QTREX Quantum Ltd. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 11,111,111 ordinary shares at $0.90 per share, raising $10 million gross, with proceeds to the company of $9.3 million after a 7% placement agent fee to A.G.P/Alliance Global Partners. The offering closed on or about August 21, 2026. This is a routine equity capital raise, not a special situation; shares are already listed on Nasdaq. No special-situation elements such as a tender, merger, or restructuring are present.
